proof: The sibling crosscheck constructs comparisons only from sarpanch rows.
It then copies the GP-level result to all rows sharing PDF and GP serial.
The sibling select_printing retains the Latin-majority, most complete printing.
The sibling validator treats cross-printing disagreement as a non-hard diagnostic; reservation normalization and block statutory checks remain hard gates.
